newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian boy dies after 11 years in coma.
newsitem.headline: Colombian boy dies after 11 years in coma.

text.p: An 11-year ordeal has finally ended for the family of a Colombian boy who fell into a coma in 1986 while under anaesthesia for a simple tonsillectomy, local news reports said on Thursday.

El Tiempo, the country's leading daily, said Benjamin Dario Alvarez, who was 15, died of pneumonia on Wednesday at the same Clinica de Occidente hospital in the southwest city of Cali where he was put under on Jan. 23, 1986, and never regained consciousness.
His parents, arguing medical malpractice, have tried repeatedly to sue the hospital and Jose Vicente Sandino, the doctor who administered the anaesthesia to then three-year-old Benjamin Dario.
But judges have said no crime was committed. Sandino told El Tiempo that Benjamin Dario was the victim of "an idiosyncratic reaction" to anaesthesia that never could have been prevented.
"You can't predict the sensitivity of an organism. All of them react differently," he said.
